program:
app "Money lent" wallet plum
table borrower name text
table loan_entry borrower ref borrower, amount money, kind pick Lent|Returned, due date?
"Out in loans" sum(loan_entry.amount where kind = Lent) - sum(loan_entry.amount where kind = Returned) big
each borrower as p
  let bal = sum(p.loan_entry.amount where kind = Lent) - sum(p.loan_entry.amount where kind = Returned)
  stack card tap edit p
    row
      p.name bold grow
      if(bal >= 0, "owes you", "you owe") abs(bal) color if(bal >= 0, good, bad)
    "Last entry" last(p.loan_entry.at) faint
form borrower, "Add borrower"
form loan_entry, "Add entry"
list loan_entry by day
describe:
Money lent, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- borrower: name: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- loan entry: borrower: a borrower; amount: money; kind: one of Lent, Returned; due: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: "Out in loans", the total amount of loan entry where kind is Lent minus the total amount of loan entry where kind is Returned.
- for each borrower:
  - a group; a tap opens the borrower for editing:
    - text: the name of the borrower.
    - text: "owes you" when bal is at least 0, otherwise "you owe", bal without its sign.
    - text: "Last entry", the latest at of the borrower's loan entry entries.
- a form to add a borrower.
- a form to add a loan entry.
- a list of loan entry by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words

program:
app "Chess clock" clock ink
state t1 dur = 600s
state t2 dur = 600s
state turn num = 0
every 1s if turn = 1 set t1 = t1 - 1s
every 1s if turn = 2 set t2 = t2 - 1s
grid 1 gap 2
  stack card align center pad 4 fill if(turn = 1, accent, soft) tap set turn = 2
    "Player 1" faint
    t1 big color if(t1 < 60s, bad, ink)
  stack card align center pad 4 fill if(turn = 2, accent, soft) tap set turn = 1
    "Player 2" faint
    t2 big color if(t2 < 60s, bad, ink)
button "Pause" tap set turn = 0
button "Reset" tap set turn = 0 then set t1 = 600s then set t2 = 600s
describe:
Chess clock, in the ink colours.
Remembers while you use it: t1, starting at 10 minutes; t2, starting at 10 minutes; turn, starting at 0.
Shows:
- every 1 seconds while turn is 1, it sets t1 to t1 minus 1 seconds.
- every 1 seconds while turn is 2, it sets t2 to t2 minus 1 seconds.
- a grid of 1 columns:
  - a group; a tap sets turn to 2:
    - text: "Player 1".
    - text: t1.
  - a group; a tap sets turn to 1:
    - text: "Player 2".
    - text: t2.
- a button "Pause"; a tap sets turn to 0.
- a button "Reset"; a tap sets turn to 0, then sets t1 to 10 minutes, then sets t2 to 10 minutes.

program:
app "Overtime" clock slate
setting rate money = 400 "Hourly rate"
setting mult num = 1.5 "Overtime multiplier"
table shift hrs num 0..16 = 8
let pay = sum(shift month, min(it.hrs, 8) * rate + max(it.hrs - 8, 0) * rate * mult)
"This month" round(pay) big
"Hours" sum(shift.hrs month) faint
"Overtime hours" sum(shift month, max(it.hrs - 8, 0)) faint
form shift, "Log shift"
list shift by day
describe:
Overtime, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- shift: hrs: number, 0 to 16, starts at 8. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Hourly rate": money, starts at 400; "Overtime multiplier": number, starts at 1.5.
Works out:
- pay is the sum of the smaller of its hrs and 8 times rate plus the larger of its hrs minus 8 and 0 times rate times mult over the shift this month.
Shows:
- text: "This month", pay rounded.
- text: "Hours", the total hrs of shift this month.
- text: "Overtime hours", the sum of the larger of its hrs minus 8 and 0 over the shift this month.
- a form to add a shift.
- a list of shift by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

app "GPA" trophy plum
table course name text, credits num 1..6 = 3, grade pick A|B|C|D|F = A
let pts = sum(course, it.credits * if(it.grade = A, 4, if(it.grade = B, 3, if(it.grade = C, 2, if(it.grade = D, 1, 0)))))
"GPA" round(pts / max(sum(course.credits), 1) * 100) / 100 big
sum(course.credits) "credits" faint
each course sort name as c
  row card gap 2 tap edit c swipe remove c
    c.name bold grow
    c.credits "cr" faint
    choice c.grade

- course: name: text; credits: number, 1 to 6, starts at 3; grade: one of A, B, C, D, F, starts at A. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- pts is the sum of its credits times 4 when its grade is A, otherwise 3 when its grade is B, otherwise 2 when its grade is C, otherwise 1 when its grade is D, otherwise 0 over the course.

- text: "GPA", pts divided by the larger of the total credits of course and 1 times 100 rounded divided by 100.

app "Bakery" bread plum
table product name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 5
let short = count(product, it.qty <= it.low)
short "products running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
each product sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
form product
describe:
Bakery, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- product: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 5. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the product have its qty is at most its low.
Shows:
- text: short, "products running low".
- for each product sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the product for editing; a swipe removes the product, with undo:
    - text: the name of the product.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the product to the qty of the product minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the product.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the product to the qty of the product plus 1.
- a form to add a product.
hurried_style: all lowercase, no punctuation, 2 to 8 words
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: start with who it is for

program:
app "Journal" book ink
table entry mood num 1..5, note long
state d new entry
row gap 1
  each ["awful", "low", "okay", "good", "great"]
    button it fill if(d.mood = index + 1, accent, soft) tap set d.mood = index + 1
field d.note "What is on your mind?"
button "Save entry" tap save d
streak(entry) "day streak," count(entry last 7 days) "entries in 7 days" head
heat last 7 days, count(entry on it)
"Mood, last 30 days. Average" round(avg(entry.mood last 30 days)) faint
trend entry last 30 days sort at, it.mood
state q text = ""
field q "Search entries"
list entry where has(note, q) by day
describe:
Journal, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- entry: mood: number, 1 to 5; note: long text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: d, a new entry being filled in; q, starting at "".
Shows:
- for "awful", "low", "okay", "good", "great":
  - a button the value; a tap sets the mood of the d to its position plus 1.
- a box to fill in the note of the d, labelled "What is on your mind?".
- a button "Save entry"; a tap saves the new d.
- text: the current day streak of entry entries, "day streak,", how many entry entries in the last 7 days, "entries in 7 days".
- a heat map of how many entry entries on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
- text: "Mood, last 30 days. Average", the average mood of entry in the last 30 days rounded.
- a line chart of its mood over entry in the last 30 days sorted by at.
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search entries".
- a list of entry where note contains q by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

program:
app "Cake price" bread plum
setting wage money = 300 "My hourly wage"
state flour money = 0
state butter money = 0
state other money = 0
state hours num = 1
state margin num = 20
field flour "Flour and sugar"
field butter "Butter and eggs"
field other "Boxes and other"
field hours "Hours of work"
let cost = flour + butter + other + hours * wage
"Margin" margin "%" faint
slider margin 0..60
"Cost" cost head
"Price" round(cost * (1 + margin / 100)) big
describe:
Cake price, in the plum colours.

- cost is flour plus butter plus other plus hours times wage.
Remembers while you use it: flour, starting at 0; butter, starting at 0; other, starting at 0; hours, starting at 1; margin, starting at 20.

- a box to fill in butter, labelled "Butter and eggs".

- a box to fill in hours, labelled "Hours of work".
- text: "Margin", margin, "%".
- a slider for margin from 0 to 60.
- text: "Cost", cost.
- text: "Price", cost times the result of 1 plus margin divided by 100 rounded.

program:
app "Committee" users ocean
table member name text, ord num 1..60
table pay member ref member, amount money
table payout member ref member
setting contribution money = 5000 "Monthly contribution"
let turn_no = count(payout) % count(member) + 1
"This month's turn" head
each member where ord = turn_no as m
  stack card gap 1
    m.name big
    "gets" contribution * count(member) faint
    button "Pot given" tap add payout member = m
count(pay month) "of" count(member) "have paid this month" head
each member sort ord as m
  row card gap 1
    m.ord bold
    m.name grow
    if(count(m.payout) > 0, "Received", "") color good faint
    if count(m.pay month) > 0
      "Paid" color good
    else
      button "Paid" tap add pay member = m, amount = contribution
form member, "Add member"
describe:
Committee, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- member: name: text; ord: number, 1 to 60. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- pay: member: a member; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- payout: member: a member. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly contribution": money, starts at 5000.
Works out:
- turn no is how many payout entries leaves over when divided by how many member entries plus 1.
Shows:
- text: "This month's turn".
- for each member where ord is turn no:
  - text: the name of the member.
  - text: "gets", contribution times how many member entries.
  - a button "Pot given"; a tap adds a payout with member set to the member.
- text: how many pay entries this month, "of", how many member entries, "have paid this month".
- for each member sorted by ord:
  - text: the ord of the member.
  - text: the name of the member.
  - text: "Received" when how many the member's payout entries is more than 0, otherwise "".
  - if how many the member's pay entries this month is more than 0:
    - text: "Paid".
  - otherwise:
    - a button "Paid"; a tap adds a pay with member set to the member, amount set to contribution.
- a form to add a member.
hurried_style: terse like a search query, 2 to 6 words
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: start with who it is for
